memoryActions.title.issue: The term 'pamćenja' (of memory, referring to the faculty) is likely incorrect in this context; 'uspomena' (recollection/memory) is more appropriate for recorded events. 'Radnje' is also a bit clunky for a friendly UI.

memoryActions.items.addMemoryNote.title.issue: Similar to entry 0, 'pamćenja' is likely incorrect. 'Beleška o uspomeni' (note about a memory) or 'beleška za uspomenu' (note for a memory) is more natural.

memoryActions.items.aiMemoryAnalysis.tit.issue: Given the context of recording and managing personal events ('Memory Note', 'Photo Memory'), 'Memory' likely refers to recollections. Therefore, 'analiza uspomena' (analysis of recollections) is more fitting than 'analiza pamćenja' (analysis of the faculty of memory).

memoryActions.items.aiMemoryAnalysis.des.issue: Consistent with entry 11, if 'memory' refers to recorded recollections, then 'obrasci uspomena' (recollection patterns) is more appropriate than 'obrasci pamćenja' (patterns of the faculty of memory).
memoryActions.items.aiMemoryAnalysis.des.suggested: Dobij uvide iz svojih obrazaca uspomena
